name: PRK101
notes: Address confirmed via JSON-LD on park101carlsbad.com (3040 Carlsbad Blvd) matching batch record. All 38 priced items came from a single Toast menu group literally named "PRK101 FOOD MENU (Uber)" -- the restaurant's own site displays no prices at all, so there was no independent same-owner source to cross-check against. Checked for a 3PD/delivery markup: all prices are round whole dollars with no cents, and dividing by common markup factors (1.1, 1.15) does not produce a consistent pattern of round base prices, which argues against a uniform delivery markup and for this being the restaurant's normal posted pricing (Toast syncs one menu across channels; "(Uber)" is likely just the internal menu-group label). A second menu-target group, "BRUNCH", exists on the page but returned 0 items at fetch time (daypart-gated, not currently being served) -- brunch items are therefore NOT included here and this menu should be treated as possibly partial for that meal period.

name: Chocolate Cafe
notes: First-party WordPress/Divi site with four separate menu pages (breakfast, dinner, dessert, drinks), all confirmed at 509 5th Ave, Gaslamp Quarter, San Diego matching the batch address exactly. Each page also carries a leftover widget-style text block with slightly different prices for a few overlapping items (e.g. Warm Apple Tart shown as both $11 and $14, Bottled Iced Tea as both $6 and $7); only the properly-headed page-body menu text ("Breakfast Menu", "Dinner & All-Day Menu", "Dessert, Sweet Crepes & Gelato Menu", "Drinks") was used, and the coffee/tea items duplicated between the breakfast page and the dedicated Drinks page were taken once from the Drinks page to avoid the conflicting figures. Modifier/add-on lines (Add chicken +$6, gluten-free flatbread +$3, extra espresso shot +$1, etc.) were dropped as non-standalone items. One item (Breakfast Flatbread) had no price on the page and was dropped.
